opening.speaker: A
opening.text: Twenty bucks says I sink a free throw from the line, first try.

sample_args.claim: Logan makes a free throw from the free-throw line.
success_criteria: Logan shoots from behind the free-throw line.
The ball goes through the hoop.
failure_criteria: Stepping over the line before the ball is released.

edge_cases.question: Does a bank shot count?
edge_cases.answer: Yes. Any shot that goes through the hoop counts.
